data.exact_reserve_text:
The 2021 result was materially impacted by losses from the 2020 underwriting year. The key drivers of these losses in the year, included winter storm Uri (GBP 12.9 million), hurricane Ida (GBP 1.8 million), Measat (GBP 0.4 million) and adverse development on 2020 losses, including covid losses (GBP 8.2 million) and the Iowa derecho (GBP 2.3 million).
Further, there was an increase in prior year reserves including a GBP 8.2 million increase on the COVID loss reserves, which are now at GBP 19.1 million (2020: GBP 10.9 million) gross of reinsurance and GBP 19.1 million (2020: GBP 9.8 million) net of reinsurance.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a mixed prior year development in 2021. While the overall gross prior year development, as calculated from the claims development triangle, was a release of GBP 16.186 million, the syndicate also reported specific strengthenings. Notably, there was an increase in prior year reserves of at least GBP 8.2 million gross related to COVID-19 losses. Additionally, the 2021 result was impacted by losses from the 2020 underwriting year, including adverse development on 2020 losses from events such as winter storm Uri, hurricane Ida, Measat, and the Iowa derecho.

data.data_quality_notes: There is a contradiction between the overall gross prior year development calculated from the claims development triangle (a release of GBP 16.186m) and narrative statements explicitly mentioning 'adverse development on 2020 losses' and an 'increase in prior year reserves including a GBP 8.2 million increase on the COVID loss reserves'. The overall direction is therefore classified as 'mixed' to reflect both components.
